verdict.rationale: Composio's docs say a session gives the agent "a small fixed set" of meta tools that discover, authenticate and execute tools at runtime. They specify 7 meta-tools, and agents find tools in a 1000+ app catalog through COMPOSIO_SEARCH_TOOLS by task description rather than preloading definitions. That directly matches the story. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that the meta-tool search works well in practice and keeps context small.
